claims_extracted.claim: The BBN TIP provides means for connecting up to 63 terminal devices to the ARPA Network.
The TIP terminal interface conforms to EIA RS-232C and permits direct connection to most data modems.
Each of the TIP's 64 ports provides program-settable control lines and monitors external status lines in addition to full-duplex serial data.
claims_extracted.notes: Full manual should be mined for exact board-level port scanner/interface implementation.

notes: Critical primary hardware source for treating TIP as serial/modem edge equipment rather than an abstract ARPANET milestone.
